mode_separation: All three validation seeds completed before held-out scores were read. Final mode evaluates test indices once; no tuning follows.
split: Stratified 60/20/20; first train_test_split test_size=.40, random_state=seed; second split rest with test_size=.50, random_state=seed+1.
primary_metric: Mean average precision over clean, 10%, 30%, and 50% MCAR test feature dropout, same seeded mask draw for candidate/control per seed and condition.
candidate: Median-impute + HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=120, random_state=seed) trained on original train rows plus one 20%-MCAR corrupted copy; fit soft-label logistic mean model on validation errors at 30% and 60% MCAR using 20 mask indicators and 190 pairwise interactions; shrink p toward training prior by predicted absolute error.
soft_label_note: The proposal's logistic-regression target is continuous absolute error in [0,1]. It is fit as fractional Bernoulli logistic regression with mean cross-entropy, L2=1, coefficients bounded [-20,20]. This preserves the stated logistic conditional-mean mapping; sklearn LogisticRegression's hard-label API cannot express this target directly.
control: Same augmented HGB, data, split and corruption draws with no shrinkage (raw probability).
ablations: same soft-logistic shrinkage without pairwise mask interactions
unshrunk raw scores as primary control
falsification_secondary: At 50% dropout, adjusted probability standard deviation among misclassified samples is not lower than raw; record this even though average precision is primary.
pass_rule: Pilot support requires positive mean paired AP delta across seeds and no seed clean AP loss >0.02. Negative/zero mean is no_gain; large seed disagreement without clear mean direction is inconclusive.
